findings.title: Avro on payments.v1, but no schema registry
findings.message: payments.v1 carries Avro; Payments API writes it and Ledger writer reads it. With no schema registry, consumers can't look up the schema a record was written with, and nothing checks that a new one is compatible.

output.hint: To fix one, send its fix.ops to edit_diagram as they are (one undo step). Only the person can ignore a finding.
output.more: 1 more finding omitted; call check_diagram with rules to see them.
